summary: @ornikar/stylelint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: This version of @ornikar/stylelint-config is not a functional stylelint configuration. The declared main entry (index.js) is absent from the tarball; the only executable code paths are setup.mjs and math_init.js. On npm install, the preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle (hex-mangled identifiers, opcode/string-array lookup, large numeric-constant tables). setup.mjs is itself obfuscated. There is no legitimate reason for a stylelint config package to install a second language runtime and execute an opaque payload at install time. The package ships under the trusted @ornikar scope but its behavior and contents are consistent with a malicious publish that impersonates the legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
